grammar.summary: 本课学习 like 的用法与购鞋场景表达。

points.title: like + 动名词的雏形
points.explanation: Do you like these shoes? 询问喜好。本课出现 Do you want... 递进需求，下一阶段将学 like + doing。

examples.en: Do you like these shoes, madam?

points.title: too 与 very 辨析
points.explanation: 修饰形容词的程度：very 大、uncomfortable 更强烈、too 表"过于"（含消极后果）：These shoes are too small for me.
